Where to Stay in Nakhon Pathom?
11 Hotels We Actually Reviewed

heroSub: 11 hand-picked Nakhon Pathom hotels across every budget — a 5-star hotel with Phra Pathommachedi views, a town-centre hotel within walking distance of the great chedi, riverside resorts on the Tha Chin River at Nakhon Chai Si and Sampran, and stays near Mahidol University in Salaya. Covering the town centre, the riverside and the Salaya side. From roughly ฿450–1,400/night.
introH2: 🛕 Why does choosing the right area in Nakhon Pathom matter so much?
introHtml: Most people pass through Nakhon Pathom to pay respects at Phra Pathommachedi and then move on — few stay the night, yet stays here are actually spread across several areas with distinctly different feels. The town centre around Phra Pathommachedi suits those who come to visit the chedi, eat at the night market and deal with Silpakorn University — several hotels are within walking distance of the great chedi. The Nakhon Chai Si and Sampran side along the Tha Chin River is the garden-and-riverside resort zone, great for families and couples wanting a getaway just about an hour from Bangkok. And the Salaya–Phutthamonthon area suits anyone with business at Mahidol University, attending a graduation or sitting exams. Many people book without checking the area and end up driving back and forth all day. This guide rounds up 11 hand-picked Nakhon Pathom hotels across every tier — all with real guest reviews, prices compared across 3 sites and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Nakhon Pathom has no metro, but it does have a southern-line railway station in the town centre where Bangkok–south trains stop, so many people arrive by train and take a short ride to the hotels around the chedi. Pick by your itinerary: the town centre around Phra Pathommachedi is near the chedi, the night market, Sanam Chandra Palace and Silpakorn University, best if you don't have a car (Mida Grande, Xen, Whale, Hop Inn); Nakhon Chai Si–Sampran along the Tha Chin River is the garden riverside resort zone, about an hour's drive from Bangkok and best with a car (RK Riverside, Sampran Riverside, Ruankrue Wan, Rest Point, Chawalun); and Salaya–Phutthamonthon is near Mahidol University, Salaya market and Salaya station, with access to western Bangkok (The Palm Salaya, 24 Poshtel). Almost every hotel has free parking, so they suit self-drivers well.

entries.name: Mida Grande Hotel Dhavaravati
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sanam Chandra · Phetkasem Rd · town centre
entries.addr: 711 Phetkasem Rd, Sanam Chandra, Mueang Nakhon Pathom
entries.storyHtml: Mida Grande Dhavaravati is the best 5-star hotel in central Nakhon Pathom, scoring 9.1 from 203 reviews. It's a high-rise in the Sanam Chandra area whose whole design draws on Dvaravati art, the city's heritage; many rooms open onto a view of Phra Pathommachedi, and there's the Thor Music Bar rooftop shaped like a Dvaravati chedi, a saltwater pool, a spa and a good breakfast. It's a 5-minute drive to the great chedi and the night market — excellent value for this class of hotel in Nakhon Pathom.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a Chedi View room if you want a full view of the great chedi, and head up to the rooftop in the evening when the chedi is lit — it's the prettiest time.
pros: The city's finest, 9.1 from 203 reviews
Many rooms face Phra Pathommachedi, lit up at night
Dvaravati rooftop bar, saltwater pool, spa, good breakfast
Town centre, 5-minute drive to the chedi and night market
cons: Sits on a main road; some surrounding plots still undeveloped
A city hotel, not a quiet riverside resort

entries.name: Xen Hotel Nakhon Pathom
entries.revCount: 467 reviews · the most in this guide
entries.badge: 💬 Most reviewed 467 · walk to the chedi
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ratchamanka Rd · Sanam Chandra · town centre
entries.addr: 528/330 Ratchamanka Rd, Phra Pathom Chedi, Mueang Nakhon Pathom
entries.storyHtml: Xen Hotel is the most-reviewed hotel in this guide with 467 reviews and a score of 9.0. Its strength is location — you can walk to Phra Pathommachedi in about 640 metres — plus rooms that are larger than expected for the price, a rooftop bar, a café downstairs and free parking. Part of the Mida group and opened in 2016, it suits visitors coming to the chedi, working, or dropping off students at Silpakorn — from just ฿850.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ratchamanka Road is busy, so if you're sensitive to noise ask for a room that doesn't face the main road or a higher floor — some upper rooms even glimpse the chedi.
pros: Most reviewed in this guide, 467 reviews, scores 9.0
Walk to Phra Pathommachedi, about 640 metres
Spacious clean rooms, rooftop bar, café downstairs
Free parking, near Silpakorn and Sanam Chandra Palace
cons: Road noise from Ratchamanka; glazing doesn't block it all
Some rooms show wear from a building opened in 2016

entries.name: Hop Inn Nakhon Pathom
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ratchamanka Rd · Sanam Chandra · near Silpakorn
entries.addr: 554 Ratchamanka Rd, Sanam Chandra, Mueang Nakhon Pathom
entries.storyHtml: Hop Inn Nakhon Pathom is the highest-scoring hotel in this guide at 9.2 from 82 reviews. It's part of the Erawan Group's Hop Inn chain, so the rooms are the same nationwide standard — simple, clean and functional, with cleanliness scoring around 9.6. It sits in the Sanam Chandra area near Silpakorn and Sanam Chandra Palace, with a large free car park — great for those running errands, passing through, or visiting relatives at Silpakorn — from just ฿650.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: There's no breakfast here, but there's a Café Amazon, rice shops and a 7-Eleven within walking distance. The chedi is about 1.8 km away, so you'll need a short ride to visit it.
pros: Highest score in this guide, 9.2; cleanliness around 9.6
Standard Hop Inn rooms, clean and predictable
Large free car park, ideal for self-drivers
Year-round fixed rates, from just ฿650
cons: The chedi is about 1.8 km away, not walkable
No breakfast, pool or gym on site

entries.name: RK Riverside Resort & Spa
entries.revCount: 256 reviews · Tha Chin River · Nakhon Chai Si
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thaiyawat · Nakhon Chai Si · Tha Chin River
tags: 🛶 Thai houses on the Tha Chin River
entries.addr: 99 Moo 4, Thaiyawat, Nakhon Chai Si, Nakhon Pathom
entries.storyHtml: RK Riverside (Reon Kruewal Riverside) is the most-reviewed of the riverside resorts, scoring 8.5 from 256 reviews with cleanliness around 9.4. Its rooms and Thai houses sit in a riverside garden at Nakhon Chai Si, many with balconies over the water, plus an outdoor pool, sauna, spa and a riverside restaurant. It's about an hour's drive from Bangkok — great for a quiet riverside getaway with family or a partner, close to the city.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a river-view room or Thai house, and check the riverside restaurant's hours as it closes fairly early in the evening. Coming as a group, a Thai house is better value.
pros: Most-reviewed riverside resort, 256 reviews; cleanliness 9.4
Thai houses on the Tha Chin River, many with river-view balconies
Pool, sauna, spa and riverside restaurant on site
About an hour from Bangkok, ideal for a weekend
cons: Some feel service doesn't fully match the price; light breakfast
You'll need a car; the surroundings aren't a walkable area

entries.name: Sampran Riverside
entries.addr: KM 32 Phetkasem Rd, Yai Cha, Sampran
entries.storyHtml: Sampran Riverside is the historic Tha Chin River garden many know as Suan Sampran / Rose Garden Riverside, scoring 8.4 from 162 reviews. It's a 70-plus-rai estate of mature trees with around 60 rooms in the garden, many with garden or river views. The draw is its organic and Thai-cultural focus — an organic farm, the Patom café, a Thai cultural village running workshops, an ozone pool and bikes to borrow. About an hour from Bangkok, it's a family getaway built for slowing down.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a Tha Chin river-view room, and check the schedule for the Suk Jai market and performances at the Thai cultural village, as they don't run every day.
pros: Historic 70+ rai riverside garden, very leafy
Organic farm, fresh tasty breakfast, Patom café
Thai cultural village, workshops, ozone pool, bikes
About an hour from Bangkok, great for families
cons: Some rooms and furniture are ageing; resort dining is pricey
You'll need a car; not a walkable area

entries.name: Ruankrue Wan Riverside Resort & Spa
entries.revCount: 41 reviews · teak Thai houses on the river
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thaiyawat · Nakhon Chai Si · Tha Chin River
tags: 🛖 Golden-teak Thai houses on the river
entries.addr: 99 Moo 4, Thaiyawat, Nakhon Chai Si, Nakhon Pathom
entries.storyHtml: Ruankrue Wan (Reon Kruewal Riverside) is a teak Thai-house resort on the Nakhon Chai Si stretch of the Tha Chin River, scoring 8.6 from 41 reviews. Some platforms list it as RK Riverside — it's the same place. The draw is the golden-teak houses set right on the water amid a leafy garden, around 45 rooms many with river-view balconies, an outdoor pool, spa and sauna, a riverside restaurant, and a highlight many mention: morning alms-giving to monks by boat. About an hour from Bangkok, it offers a Thai feel that's rare so close to the city.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Get up early to join the alms-giving by boat — a riverside scene you rarely see — and order dinner before about 8:30 pm, as the kitchen stops taking orders fairly early.
pros: Golden-teak Thai houses on the river, full of character
Alms-giving by boat, a rare riverside tradition
Pool, spa, sauna and a buffet breakfast praised for its coffee
About an hour from Bangkok, quiet and peaceful
cons: Some bathrooms and fittings are ageing
You'll need a car; Grab is hard to get at times; kitchen closes early

entries.name: The Palm Hotel Salaya
entries.badge: 🎓 Walk to Mahidol · spacious rooms with balconies
entries.addr: Salaya Soi 1, Phutthamonthon Sai 4 Rd, Salaya, Phutthamonthon
entries.storyHtml: The Palm Hotel Salaya is a small Salaya hotel within about a 4-minute walk of the Mahidol University gate, scoring 8.6 from 100 reviews. Its roughly 20 rooms all have air-con, a fridge, a large desk and a private balcony; reviewers consistently note the rooms are larger than expected for the price, the Wi-Fi is good and it's fairly quiet, with an in-house café, a minimart and free parking. It's ideal for parents, graduation visitors, exam-takers and anyone with Mahidol business — from just ฿600.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The 4-storey building has no lift, so ask for a lower floor if you have a lot of luggage, and book weeks ahead during Mahidol graduation or exam periods as rooms fill fast.
pros: About a 4-minute walk to the Mahidol University gate
Spacious clean rooms, all with balconies and desks
Good, fast Wi-Fi and fairly quiet
Free parking, in-house minimart and café
cons: 4-storey building with no lift; upper rooms mean stairs
Some rooms catch water-pump or street noise from the soi

entries.name: Chawalun Resort
entries.addr: 99/1 Moo 9, Lam Hoei, Don Tum, Nakhon Pathom
entries.storyHtml: Chawalun Resort is the most-reviewed property in this guide, with over 1,005 reviews and a score of 8.3. It's a 50-plus-rai estate in Don Tum with a lake at its centre and rooms ranging from blocks to over-water houses. The draw is family activities — a pool with a slide, a waterfall pool, pedal boats, fish feeding, cycling and a wooden suspension bridge — so kids stay busy all day without leaving. From just ฿800, it's built for families and groups.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For the best views ask for a lakeside or over-water house at booking, and you'll need a car as it's in Don Tum, about 20–30 minutes from the town centre and the chedi.
pros: Most-reviewed in this guide, over 1,005 reviews
Large leafy lakeside grounds, private and quiet
Slide pool, pedal boats and suspension bridge keep kids busy
Many room types for groups and large families
cons: An older resort; some rooms are dated with minor wear
In Don Tum; you need a car and it's far from town and the chedi

entries.name: Rest Point Sampran
entries.revCount: 15 reviews · on Phetkasem Rd · Nakhon Chai Si
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Khun Kaeo · Nakhon Chai Si · Phetkasem Rd
entries.addr: 9/51-53 Phetkasem Rd, Khun Kaeo, Nakhon Chai Si
entries.storyHtml: Rest Point Sampran is a small roadside hotel on Phetkasem Road known for clean, quiet rooms, scoring 8.2. It's a family-run place of about 17–18 rooms on the Bangkok-bound side; the offer is straightforward — clean, quiet rooms, easy parking and a fridge with free water in every room. It suits drivers on Phetkasem wanting a single night or a stopover before heading into Bangkok — from just ฿600.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The hotel takes cash only, so bring enough, and call ahead if you'll check in late or out early, as it's owner-run.
pros: Very clean, quiet rooms, ideal for a one-night stopover
Free parking right at the door, handy for drivers
Fridge, free water, tea, coffee and snacks provided
On Phetkasem Rd, easy in and out, near Sampran
cons: Cash only; no breakfast and no lift
A roadside stay, no resort atmosphere

entries.name: Whale Hotel Nakhon Pathom
entries.badge: 💸 Big rooms, low price, in town
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ratchawithi Rd · town centre · near the chedi
entries.addr: 151/79 Ratchawithi Rd, Phra Pathom Chedi, Mueang Nakhon Pathom
entries.storyHtml: Whale Hotel is an older town-centre hotel whose draw is big rooms at a low price, scoring 7.6 from 312 reviews. It's a large building on Ratchawithi Road near Phra Pathommachedi and Sanam Chandra Palace, with rooms roomier than expected for the ฿700-ish price, an indoor pool, a gym and a large car park. The trade-off is an older, partly-renovated building with a plain feel — but it suits budget travellers who want a big room in the centre of town.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Room quality varies in a big building like this, so ask to see the room at check-in or request a more recently renovated one, and compare Agoda with Trip.com before booking.
pros: Rooms bigger than expected at a budget price, from ฿700
Indoor pool and gym on site
Spacious, easy parking
Town centre, near Phra Pathommachedi
cons: Building and carpets are dated, plain atmosphere
Some in-room amenities aren't always fully stocked

entries.name: 24 Poshtel Salaya
entries.badge: 💰 Cheapest in this guide · near Mahidol
entries.addr: 66/23-24 Salaya–Nakhon Chai Si Rd, Salaya, Phutthamonthon
entries.storyHtml: 24 Poshtel Salaya is the cheapest property in this guide, scoring 7.5 from 17 reviews. Its clear strength is location — about a 300-metre walk to the Mahidol University gate — and prices from just ฿450, with 13 rooms ranging from singles with a shared bathroom to Japanese-style rooms with a private bathroom. Honestly though, it's a budget hostel: room standards vary and reviewers note firm beds and a musty smell in some rooms — best for those prioritising price and the location near Mahidol.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Choose a Japanese-style room with a private bathroom, which reviews better, and read the check-in policy before booking, as some reviews mention an early check-in fee.
pros: Cheapest in this guide, from just ฿450
About a 300-metre walk to Mahidol University
Several room types, including Japanese-style with private bath
Plenty of eateries and shops nearby
cons: A budget hostel; room standards vary
Reviews note firm beds, poor sound insulation and mustiness

adviceTitle: How to choose the right Nakhon Pathom hotel for you?

advice.bodyHtml: → Xen Hotel ฿850, walk to the chedi, most reviewed · or Mida Grande Dhavaravati ฿1,400, luxe 5-star with chedi views · or Whale Hotel ฿700, big budget rooms in the centre

advice.head: Travelling as a family with kids and activities

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate and may change by date and season — always check live prices and compare 3 sites before booking. During long holidays, the Phra Pathommachedi fair (around November) and Mahidol University graduation/exam periods, rooms fill fast, so book 2–4 weeks ahead. Nakhon Pathom has no metro but does have a central railway station; the Tha Chin riverside resorts at Nakhon Chai Si–Sampran are best with a car. Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Nakhon Pathom hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area is best to stay in Nakhon Pathom?
faq.a: It depends on your plans and whether you have a car. The town centre around Phra Pathommachedi suits those visiting the chedi, eating at the night market and dealing with Silpakorn (Mida Grande, Xen, Whale, Hop Inn). Nakhon Chai Si–Sampran on the Tha Chin River is the garden riverside resort zone, great for a getaway near Bangkok (RK Riverside, Sampran Riverside, Ruankrue Wan, Rest Point). Salaya–Phutthamonthon suits anyone with Mahidol University business (The Palm Salaya, 24 Poshtel), while Don Tum has a lakeside garden resort for families (Chawalun).

faq.q: ❓ How much do Nakhon Pathom hotels cost?
faq.a: Nakhon Pathom is good value: hostels and budget stays start around ฿450–700 (24 Poshtel, The Palm Salaya, Rest Point, Hop Inn, Whale); 3-star town hotels run about ฿800–850 (Xen, Chawalun); and the 5-star hotel and Tha Chin riverside resorts start around ฿1,400–1,500 (Mida Grande, Sampran Riverside, RK Riverside, Ruankrue Wan).

faq.q: ❓ Which Nakhon Pathom hotels are within walking distance of Phra Pathommachedi?
faq.a: The easiest walk to the chedi is Xen Hotel, about 640 metres away. Mida Grande Dhavaravati and Whale Hotel are central, around the chedi, a 5-minute drive away. If visiting the chedi is your main goal, the hotels around it are far more convenient than the Salaya or Nakhon Chai Si side.

faq.q: ❓ What Tha Chin River resorts does Nakhon Pathom have?
faq.a: There are several riverside options. RK Riverside Resort & Spa and Ruankrue Wan Riverside (the same place, Reon Kruewal) are teak Thai-house resorts at Nakhon Chai Si; Sampran Riverside is the historic 70-rai garden at Sampran with an organic focus. All are about an hour's drive from Bangkok and great for a family riverside getaway — you'll want a car.

faq.q: ❓ Where should I stay near Mahidol University, Salaya?
faq.a: In this guide, the ones near Mahidol are The Palm Hotel Salaya at ฿600, about a 4-minute walk to the Mahidol gate with spacious rooms, balconies and desks, ideal for parents and remote workers; and 24 Poshtel Salaya at ฿450, a hostel about 300 metres from Mahidol, cheaper but a hostel standard. Rooms fill fast during graduation and exam periods, so book ahead.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a Nakhon Pathom hotel?
faq.a: On regular weekdays, 1–2 weeks ahead is enough. But during long holidays, the Phra Pathommachedi fair (around November) and Mahidol University graduation/exam periods, rooms fill very fast — especially the hotels around the chedi and the Salaya stays — so book 2–4 weeks or more in advance.
